items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 26:1
items.html: For the measure of the magnitude and the whole being of the inner light depends on the magnitude of the measure of coarseness and detaining that is in the screen, since the surrounding light is rejected and remains outside the Partzuf because of that very detaining and coarseness in the screen. Thus an abundance of coarseness is found to distance the surrounding light according to the magnitude of its measure, and to bring near and to enlarge the inner light according to the magnitude of its measure. They are therefore opposite from one extreme to the other. (ibid.)
